title: Is there a Script similar to Fullscreen++ for XP ?

posts.author: Neil_Marie
posts.body:
I've wanted to make a game with RPG Maker XP for a long time but what's holding me back is how tiny the game window is on modern monitors. I wanted to know if there's a script for XP that allows you to scale the window size in increments with a key bind like with
Fullscreen++ by Zeus81
I've tried using
RMXP Ace
but I keep getting errors due to me being on the Steam version. (1.05a)

posts.author: thalesgal
posts.body:
